name: Extra Marital Affairs
overview: Scripture clearly defines marriage as a sacred union where a man and woman become one flesh, emphasizing faithfulness within this bond (Genesis 2:24). The commandment 'Thou shalt not commit adultery' (Exodus 20:14; Matthew 5:27) underscores God's prohibition of extra marital affairs, highlighting their destructive nature both spiritually and personally (Proverbs 6:27, 6:32). Furthermore, God expresses His hatred for treacherous dealings and broken commitments in marriage, warning against dealing treacherously with one's spouse (Malachi 2:16).
